Do you need photos, and where do I send them?
Yep, photos (and especially videos) are important on By Rotation, but where you send them depends on what you’re doing:
Listing / rentals:
Upload high-quality photos directly in the app when you create your listing.
Lenders and renters should also take and keep their own timestamped videos/photos as proof of condition before sending/after receiving items; these are kept by you for evidence in case of a dispute, not sent anywhere by default.
Posting / returns:
Before posting an item (as lender or renter), take clear photos or videos for proof of condition and keep them stored your side.
Disputes or issues:
If there’s damage or the item arrives in poor condition, you should send photos/videos directly to the other party via the app chat.
If a dispute escalates (e.g., item in poor condition or cleaning/damage claims), evidence may be emailed to help@byrotation.com when our team is mediating.
So yes, you do need photos (and videos), but mostly you keep them as evidence and share via in-app messages or email our support if we’re helping with a dispute.

It really depends what’s gone wrong with your rental:

Item arrived late / poor condition / doesn’t fit (per lender policy): You may be eligible for a refund (often as app credit), usually if you return it within 24 hours and follow the in‑app refund process.
Item damaged beyond repair, lost or stolen: You won’t get a replacement from us—instead, the renter must replace the item or pay its market value to the lender.

So you’ll usually receive a refund for service/condition issues, but replacement or value reimbursement applies when the garment itself is ruined or never returned.
